title: Chapter 699
paragraphs: Chapter 699
Episode 178. Deepening Concerns (3)
"A true Creator...."
Jin said.
Everyone might have thought about this at least once. If God created the world, who created God?
The answer to this question is usually similar. There is another God above God, or it started to exist by itself.
Orgal was saying that it was the Sun God, 'Kinzelo.'
Unlike many fraudsters who have claimed to be the Sun God, Orgal's claim certainly had credibility.

Jin had experienced the authority of the Sun God himself. Valeria, who had suffered a fatal injury, was perfectly healed in the area formed by the lingering energy of the Sun God that Zephyr called a sanctuary.

And what about Bale, said to be a creature of the Sun? He was born with enormous authority and, along with divine combat power, he had resistance to historical manipulation, all without any training or enlightenment.
"What do you think, Sir Jin! You just found out the biggest secret of the world. Doesn't your heart flutter?"
At Marjiella's question, Jin shrugged.
Even if the Sun God really existed, it wasn't a very interesting story to Jin.
Rather, it increased his troubles. If he fails to bring down Kinzelo in time, he will have to confront such a high-dimensional being.
Of course, this is only if the Sun God really exists and resurrection is possible.
"Well, I'm not sure. Bale, what about you?"
"I don't find it very interesting either."
At Bale's grumpy answer, Jin inwardly breathed a sigh of relief.
If Bale had longed for his unidentified creator, it would have added another factor of anxiety.
Bale's only interest was Sarah Runcandel. Now that Sarah had died a thousand years ago, the world was nothing more than a vast vacant lot to him.
But on that vacant lot, those who killed Sarah, as Jin informed him, are still alive. The last remaining meaning of Bale's life was to annihilate them.
'Bale, are you really not curious about the being who created you?'
"Are you deaf? Why do you keep asking the same thing, it's annoying. I'm not interested, and I'm not curious."
Most of Kinzelo's executives looked flustered at Bale's aggressive response, and Orgal seemed somewhat saddened.
'Rather, it's Orgal who has the longing for the Sun God, not Bale.'
Orgal is a devil, and among them, he is a devil king with the nickname of Demon Beast King. Jin thought that he did not fit well with the combination of him and the Sun God.
[The fragments of the Creator are no different from other orphans, what a pity. He would have been aware from birth that he was a creature of the Sun God. Cough....]
"Hey, Jin. I don't like that guy, can I hit him just once? It seems like he's treating me like a fool."
"We can't beat a sick person, and we're allies right now."
Kinzelo's executives were continually disappointed in the behavior shown by Bale, whom they had greatly anticipated.
Jin, on the one hand, understood their disappointment. He felt the same when he first saw Bale.
"Lord Bale. Imagine a world purified by the return of the Sun God."
When Marjiella spoke like a cheerful, misguided fanatic, Bale chuckled.
"No thanks."
"What if, in that world, Lord Bale can meet the person you love the most again?"
"Meet Sarah... again?"

"Of course. The Sun God will never overlook the deep sadness you hold, Lord Bale. After all, you are a part of the Sun God, so your sadness is also his. The only way to purify it would be for Lady Sarah to return."
At that moment, Jin understood more clearly why Kinzelo made Zephyr and the Devil Stone in the past, and why they were fixated on Bubarr Gaston.
'Fragment... It must be Bubarr, that disgusting guy, who is supposed to gather and combine the fragments of the Sun God.'
That means there could be more than one entity like Bale.
Jin thought anew that Kinzelo and his followers were not as stupid as they had seemed. The cards they held were all excessively dangerous.
It was the same with all their enemies. Just thinking of Rosa was overwhelming, let alone the Devil King and the Sun God. His mind was in turmoil.
He again observed Bale's demeanor. He seemed slightly shaken by the prospect of meeting Sarah again.
Jin decided to quietly watch how he would react.

"Cut the bullshit. Even if the so-called Sun God resurrects Sarah, that wouldn't be the Sarah I knew. It would be another Sandra Zephyr. So don't ever bring up Sarah again. If it weren't for the Gold Beast, you guys would already be dust scattered somewhere in the world."
Jin exclaimed in admiration.
"Good answer, Bale."
Seeing Bale not at all enchanted by Kinzelo, even with the mention of Sarah, Jin felt inexplicably proud.
"Lord Bale, indeed! There seems to be a misunderstanding. What I meant was...."

"Enough with the nonsense. I gave you a chance to tempt Bale out of consideration. It's true that I somewhat ignored your kindness. I've heard a bit about Zito as well. But since you've failed, stop pestering Bale. It means to show Orgal recovering."
[Cough!]

"Look at this, he's still coughing as if he's about to collapse. How on earth is he going to fight Rosa, showing such a weak state? Orgal, when I unsealed Bale, I saw Rosa briefly. She seemed to be getting stronger faster than you expected."
-It seems everyone is worried about when Rosa will move, so let me tell you one thing. It will take her at least a year to take action personally. Until then, there will be no end of the world.
At the first temporary alliance meeting, Orgal had suggested that there was little chance Rosa would act within a year.

"It's only been about three months since that first meeting when you said it would take at least a year. But Rosa, who I met in the seal of Bale... she was much stronger than when we faced the Sword Garden. Orgal, did you not feel anything about this?"
[I didn't. But if what you say is true, the day of the final battle may be closer.]
"Right. The already scarce time has become more urgent. That's why I brought Bale here, knowing it would benefit Kinzelo. I didn't bring him here to quench your thirst for the Sun God."
Orgal nodded.
[I need Bale's power to recover.]
At Jin's signal, a ring formed above Bale's head, wings formed on his back, and a golden aura erupted.
Then, Orgal's smoky, vaguely formed body started to darken rapidly, like drought-stricken land absorbing a sudden rain.
Bale was very unhappy to see his energy being absorbed, but he remained silent.
"Jin, he's stealing my power. Can't we block it?"
"If it's causing permanent damage, try blocking it for now."
"It's not... but it's a bit of a drain."
This was only a small drain from Bale's perspective. The energy of the Sun God he possessed was almost infinitely large by human standards.
Watching Orgal's physical form become increasingly clear, Jin was reminded of Murakan.
'It feels like when Murakan absorbed my spirit energy to recover. Although this seems much more effective....'
The way Murakan tried to drink in Jin's spirit energy as soon as he woke up from the storm stone, and the way Orgal was absorbing Bale's energy, seemed quite similar.
That meant Orgal was a being born from the Sun God. This was similar to the guardian dragons receiving power from their gods.
[Hooooo...]
When Orgal took a deep breath, he was no longer in a ghostly form like before.
His face had distinct features, and his previously hazy body had taken on a distinct grey color.
There were still some cloudy parts left here and there, but if you ignore them, he looked similar to other ordinary demons.
However, it seemed impossible to recover any further through Bale's energy.
"Finally, the coughing has stopped. Now you look like the other demons."
[This sensation... It's been quite a while...]
"But it seems that recovery through Bale is limited, right? To recover fully, you need the Sanctuary of Zipple."
Jin guessed without difficulty that the Sun God's power left in Zipple's Sanctuary was of much higher purity than what Bale had.
"Congratulations, Master."
Zephyrin said, kneeling on one knee to Orgal.
Jin didn't feel any particular change in energy from the recovered Orgal, but he recognized that his power had grown immensely through Zephyrin.
Zephyrin was emanating an energy that was incomparably stronger than before.
If Zephyrin had had this kind of power when they first met in the Black King's herb field, Jin's story would have ended there.

Zephyrin is a being that receives power from Orgal. Until now, he had been overexerting himself to pull on Orgal's remaining power, but now, despite Zephyrin's energy being larger than ever, there was no particular strain on Orgal.

"I'm finally getting a little trust in you, Orgal. I was wondering what would happen if we just treated the symptoms until the day of the final battle. But surely, it won't get worse again if you use too much power, like in Calduran's Snowfield, right?"
[You need not worry. Unless I die, I'll be able to maintain this state.]
While this was a pleasant answer considering the decisive battle with Rosa, it was a terrifying story if one imagined the future battles with Kinzelo.
[However, I will need an adaptation phase, like the aberration. It should take a few days.]
"I'm relieved if it's just a few days. Don't overdo it because you're happy to have your strength back after a long time. You've been so feeble for a while, I can't help but worry."
Orgal gave Jin a smirk.
[I've only regained about 10% of my power, so I'm not too excited.]
"So you're saying this is just 10%......"
[Didn't I tell you during the meeting, if I had been intact from the beginning, things wouldn't have gone this way.]
During the slight disturbance at Orgal's words, which didn't sound like a bluff at all, Bale turned his head and asked Jin a question.
[Now that he doesn't seem like a patient anymore, is he a match!?]
Jin laughed softly.
